name: gallery-section-v6
title: Gallery Section v6
description: Framed photos fade in as a stacked deck, then expand into an overlapping row with a larger center card that carries the title, caption, and pill button. Drag, click a neighbor, or use the dots. Photos blur slightly while the row is moving.
